pairs: And Jesus departed from the temple
so as to show him the buildings of the temple.
But he said to them in response:
non relinquetur hic lapis super lapidem,
there shall not remain here stone upon stone,
Sedente autem eo super montem Oliveti,
when he was seated at the Mount of Olives,
the disciples drew near to him privately,
And what will be the sign of your advent and of the consummation of the age?”
And answering, Jesus said to them:
multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes:
For many will come in my name saying,

Take care not to be disturbed.

hæc autem omnia initia sunt dolorum.
But all these things are just the beginning of the sorrows.
Then they will hand you over to tribulation,
et eritis odio omnibus gentibus propter nomen meum.
And you will be hated by all nations for the sake of my name.
And then many will be led into sin,
and will have hatred for one another.
And many false prophets will arise,
and they will lead many astray.
the charity of many will grow cold.

But whoever will have persevered until the end,
Et prædicabitur hoc Evangelium regni in universo orbe,
And this Gospel of the kingdom shall be preached throughout the entire world,
as a testimony to all nations.
And then the consummation will occur.
quæ dicta est a Daniele propheta,
when you will have seen the abomination of desolation,
which was spoken of by the prophet Daniel,
then those who are in Judea,
let them flee to the mountains.
And whoever is on the roof,
non descendat tollere aliquid de domo sua:
let him not descend to take anything from his house.
And whoever is in the field,
let him not turn back to take his tunic.
woe to those who are pregnant or nursing in those days.
Orate autem ut non fiat fuga vestra in hieme,
But pray that your flight may not be in winter,
For then there will be a great tribulation,
qualis non fuit ab initio mundi usque modo,
such as has not been from the beginning of the world until the present,
and such as will not be.
Et nisi breviati fuissent dies illi,
And unless those days had been shortened,
sed propter electos breviabuntur dies illi.
But for the sake of the elect, those days shall be shortened.

do not be willing to believe it.

Therefore, if they will have said to you,
do not choose to go out,
or, ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’
do not be willing to believe it.
Sicut enim fulgur exit ab oriente,
For just as lightning goes out from the east,
and appears even in the west,
ita erit et adventus Filii hominis.
so shall it be also at the advent of the Son of man.
there also will the eagles be gathered together.

And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun will be darkened,
et luna non dabit lumen suum,
and the moon will not give its light,
and the stars will fall from heaven,
and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
et tunc parebit signum Filii hominis in cælo:

et tunc plangent omnes tribus terræ:

et congregabunt electos ejus a quatuor ventis,

a summis cælorum usque ad terminos eorum.

cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit,

But if that evil servant has said in his heart,

he begins to strike his fellow servants,
and he eats and drinks with the inebriated:
veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat,
then the lord of that servant will arrive on a day that he does not expect,
